displayName: MSEA-R91 system-chain whole-picture map and freshness control
priorAbsorption: MSEA-R90 Audit A (reviewer-accepted, material commit 645df8b83) is the sole semantic authority for the five lane verdicts this map records; this tranche adds a stable reference presentation and a read-only freshness-detection layer without producing a new audit.

findings.summary: The human and machine system-chain map surfaces only reviewer-accepted MSEA-R90 Audit A lane verdicts, without strengthening or weakening any claim.
findings.nextAction: No further action required; future lane-verdict changes require a fresh governed review, not an edit to this map alone.

findings.summary: The new freshness checker detects source-hash drift, path loss, Markdown/JSON disagreement, and review-age expiry, but never auto-rewrites a lane's semantic verdict.
findings.nextAction: Any future semantic verdict change must come from a governed review that reads the drifted source, not from this checker's own detection signal.

findings.summary: Corrected the GC-019 roadmap citation and ten distinct stale/missing Operational Reference Index citations identified by MSEA-R90 Audit A to their confirmed archive-qualified successors, and marked the H2 citation explicitly missing rather than substituting an unproven equivalent.
findings.nextAction: Re-verify basename and path existence after any future edit to either corrected owner document.

nextScanRecommendation: Do not rescan MSEA-R90 Audit A from zero; use its reviewer-accepted terminal rows as the unchanged semantic baseline. Any future rescan of the map itself should recompute fingerprints and review age through the freshness checker, not through a manual diff.
